ACI-WORKFLOW-BINDING-V1:
Independently review the existing proposal at research/repository-irreducible-problem-inventory/team-design/findings.md. Read AGENTS.md first and obey it. Read the proposal in full, then consult research/repository-irreducible-problem-inventory/research-initial-definitions.md and research/repository-irreducible-problem-inventory/stages/exploration/findings.md only as governing context. Do not edit or create files and do not launch agents. Attack through one lens: operability and role non-vacuity. Test whether every proposed seat has a distinct discriminating contribution, whether corpus boundaries and budgets are executable, whether dependencies and outputs are sufficient for parent synthesis, whether any hidden work is pushed onto the parent, and whether the plan honors the owner's relaxed candidate-and-hypothesis objective. Produce the complete inline review.md payload: Coverage, findings table with exact quotations from the proposal, severity, one-line proposed fix, per-artifact KEEP or FIX verdict, and ordered change requests. Drop speculative findings you cannot support from the literal artifact. If there are zero findings, state each attack attempted and why it survived.
